scenario: A song plays its four tracks, looping, and stops
name: hello: SEQ plays the demo song at 120 BPM: the bass A2, the melody E5, a chord and the drums each alone in bar 1, all together in bar 2, then again from the top; SEQ again stops it
note: Stopping releases the notes, as releasing a key does: Phase BELL (the melody) has a long release (90 of 127), so its tail fades after the stop. Bar 2 would sound at rms ~2500 from 6000 ms if the song still played.
